$comment: VAPP-108: the ergonomics corpus. ~30 app-building prompts a product person would type, run through catalogPrompt() against Claude (eval/record.ts; the replies are cached under eval/fixtures/<id>.json so CI never calls the model) and scored by eval/score.ts. `widths` = the web viewports the surface renders at (eval/render.ts; the default is 1280); `appView` = the app screen it mirrors (packages/view-catalog/views.json id) whose stored shots the spacing parity reads; `expects` = what the visual rubric looks for in THIS surface (primaryAction: exactly one default Button; emptyState: an EmptyState or emptyText; loading: a Skeleton / Spinner / loading prop; form: fields inside a Form; list: a List or Table over a data template; overlay: a Dialog / Drawer / AlertDialog / Menu).

prompts.title: Team settings
prompts.prompt: A settings page for a team: the team name, its URL slug, a timezone picker and a danger zone that deletes the team after a confirmation.

prompts.title: Issue list with filters
prompts.prompt: An issue list with a search box and filters by status and assignee. Each row shows the identifier, the title, a status badge and the assignee. Pressing a row opens the issue.

prompts.title: Device dashboard
prompts.prompt: A dashboard of the team's devices: each device with its online status, operating system and app version; a row opens the device. Show how many are online.

prompts.title: Sign-up form
prompts.prompt: A sign-up form: name, email (must be valid), password (at least 8 characters), a terms checkbox that must be ticked. One Create account button.

prompts.title: Chat
prompts.prompt: A chat screen: a scrolling list of messages (sender, text, time; mine on the right) and a composer with attachments at the bottom.

prompts.title: Kanban board
prompts.prompt: A kanban board with three columns, Todo, In progress and Done, each a list of cards with the issue title and its assignee's avatar.

prompts.title: Invoices table
prompts.prompt: A sortable, selectable table of invoices: number, customer, amount in euros, due date and status. When rows are selected, offer a Mark paid action.

prompts.title: Onboarding wizard
prompts.prompt: A three-step onboarding wizard: 1 pick a plan, 2 connect a repository, 3 invite members. Show the progress, a Back and a Next button; the last step finishes.

prompts.title: Empty board
prompts.prompt: The empty state of a board with no issues yet: say so, explain what a board is for in one sentence and offer to create the first issue.

prompts.title: Notification inbox (phone)
prompts.prompt: A mobile notification inbox: notifications grouped by day (Today, Yesterday, Earlier), each with an icon, a title, a one-line preview, the time and an unread marker. It must read well at phone widths.

prompts.title: Profile card
prompts.prompt: A user profile card: avatar, name, role, email, when they were last active, with Edit and Message buttons.

prompts.title: Sign in
prompts.prompt: A sign-in card: email, password, a Remember me switch, a Sign in button, Continue with Google, and a Forgot password link.

prompts.title: Pricing
prompts.prompt: A pricing page with three plans side by side (Free, Team, Business); the Team plan is recommended. Each plan lists its features and has a Choose button. Stack the plans on phones.

prompts.title: File browser
prompts.prompt: A file browser: the current path as a breadcrumb, a list of folders and files with size and modified date, an Upload button, and a context menu per row with Rename, Move and Delete.

prompts.title: New event
prompts.prompt: A form to create a calendar event: title, a date range, start and end time, attendees as chips, a description, and a switch for a reminder. Save and Cancel.

prompts.title: Metrics dashboard
prompts.prompt: A metrics dashboard: four stat tiles (users, sessions, errors, p95 latency) each with a trend sparkline, a line chart of daily sessions over the last 30 days, and a table of the top ten pages.

prompts.title: Notification preferences
prompts.prompt: Notification preferences: for each event type (assigned to me, mentioned, comment on my issue, PR merged) a switch for email and one for push. A Save button that is disabled until something changed.

prompts.title: Delete confirmation
prompts.prompt: A destructive confirmation for deleting the board 'Mobile App' which has 42 issues: the user must type the board's name before the Delete button enables.

prompts.title: Search results
prompts.prompt: Search results for a query across issues, people and files, grouped with a count per group; each group is a list of rows; say when nothing matched.

prompts.title: Agent progress
prompts.prompt: A coding agent's progress: the steps it took (read three files, ran the tests), the current step still running, and a failed step that expands to show its output.

prompts.title: Invite members
prompts.prompt: Invite members to the team: email addresses as chips, a role select (Member, Owner), an optional note and a Send invites button. Below, the pending invites with a Revoke action each.

prompts.title: Photo gallery
prompts.prompt: A photo gallery: a grid of thumbnails; pressing one opens a dialog with the full picture, its caption and Previous / Next.

prompts.title: Order tracking
prompts.prompt: An order tracking view: the order number, where it is (placed, packed, shipped, delivered), the items with quantity and price, the total, and a Contact support button.

prompts.title: Inbox split view
prompts.prompt: An inbox split view: the message list on the left, the open message on the right (sender, subject, body, Reply and Archive). On phones only one column shows at a time.

prompts.title: API keys
prompts.prompt: A settings section for API keys: a table of keys (name, prefix, created, last used), a Create key button opening a dialog with a name and a scope, and a Revoke action per key with a confirmation.

prompts.title: Issue detail, loading
prompts.prompt: An issue detail page while it loads: placeholders for the title, the description and three comments, replaced by the real content once the data is bound.

prompts.title: Feedback
prompts.prompt: A feedback form: a rating out of five stars, a category (Bug, Idea, Praise), a message, an optional screenshot upload, and a thank-you toast after sending.

prompts.title: Now playing
prompts.prompt: A now-playing card: album art, the track title and artist, a progress slider with elapsed and total time, previous / play-pause / next, and the queue below.

prompts.title: Command result
prompts.prompt: The result of a command an agent ran: the command line, its output with terminal colours, the exit code, and Copy and Run again buttons.

prompts.title: Team switcher
prompts.prompt: An app bar whose title is the current team and opens a menu: the other teams, Create team, and Sign out.
